drafted_from: tool:collect-the-comments-that-name-a-character's row in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/ and the tests in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/
start_here: Say to your AI: "Collect the comments that name the parrot from the downloaded comments of my videos." It runs tool:collect-the-comments-that-name-a-character with my mention pattern.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one settings row of yours (record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) or the settings you pass, and works on files in the show's folder.
instructions: 1. Make the show's folder and the YouTube library folder the run may change, and download the comments with yt-dlp --write-comments into <youtube folder>/comments/<id>.info.json. Put the keys the row needs (mention_pattern) in your settings row or pass them as settings.

2. Say the sentence in start_here to your AI. It calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:collect-the-comments-that-name-a-character and the input in the worked example; the door asks for the granted folder.
3. Read the last line it prints, {"result": ...}, or {"error": ...} saying what to fix (a missing settings key is named).

worked_examples.title: Two of three top comments name the parrot
worked_examples.given: From the sample run in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json and test_mentions_are_collected_and_coded in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/test_word_rules.py: vid-a has three top-level comments, c1 "The parrot is so funny" (9 likes), c2 "Nice fog shots" (20 likes) and c3 "I missed the parrot" (3 likes).
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"mentions": "{grant:change-a-folder}/show/comments-character.tsv", "videos": 1, "comments_read": 3, "mentioning": 2}}; comments-character.tsv lists c1 then c3 (most liked first), and comments-summary.tsv has vid-a with mention_share 0.667, mention_like_share 0.375 and mentions_in_top20 2.
